title: Practice 10: с-: down, and together — раз-: apart

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Обоих выпустили пока… до суда, не ___ (сбежать / сбегать — to run down).
exercises.why: Дети сбежались на детскую площадь. — The children ran (from all directions) to the playground. — в / на + acc.; к + dat.. **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)** — Divergent movement in various directions from one center. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  From Иван Шмелёв, «Солнце мёртвых».
exercises.context: Дети сбежались на детскую площадь. — The children ran (from all directions) to the playground. — в / на + acc.; к + dat..

exercises.q: Мигом ___ (слететь / слетать — to fly down, to fly away) с пенька Пашка.
exercises.why: **слете́ть** — **слета́ть** — to fly down (from), to fly away (from); (colloquial) to fall down (from), to fall (off). **сбежа́ть** — **сбега́ть** — to run down (from); to run away, to make off, to flee, to break out. **снести́** — **сноси́ть** — to carry down; to carry to. **свести́** — **своди́ть** — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together. **свезти́** — **свози́ть** — (perfective only, transitive) to transport, to drive, to convey; (colloquial, perfective only, transitive) to transport there and back, to drive there and back. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Аркадий Гайдар, «Голубая чашка».
exercises.context: слете́ть** — **слета́ть — to fly down (from), to fly away (from); (colloquial) to fall down (from), to fall (off).

exercises.q: До чего его ___ (разносить / разнести — to carry, to convey, to deliver)!
exercises.why: **разнести́** — **разноси́ть** — to carry, to convey, to deliver; (colloquial) (news, rumor etc) to spread around. **развести́** — **разводи́ть** — to take along, to bring; to conduct; to part, to move apart, to pull apart, to separate. **развезти́** — **развози́ть** — to deliver, to transport (multiple people or things to their respective destinations); (colloquial, impersonal). — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Викентий Вересаев, «В тупике».
exercises.context: разнести́** — **разноси́ть — to carry, to convey, to deliver; (colloquial) (news, rumor etc) to spread around.

exercises.q: До ___ (слезть / слезать — to come down, to get down, to dismount) дошел.
exercises.why: **сле́зть** — **слеза́ть** — to come down, to get down (from), to dismount (from); (colloquial) to come down. **сойти́сь** — **сходи́ться** — to meet, to come together; to converge, to coalesce. **съе́хаться** — **съезжа́ться** — to meet (on one's way); to assemble, to come together, to gather. **сбежа́ться** — **сбега́ться** — to come running (of many people). **разойти́сь** — **расходи́ться** — to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread; to break up (of a crowd, meeting, etc.). — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Максим Горький, «Детство».
exercises.context: сле́зть** — **слеза́ть — to come down, to get down (from), to dismount (from); (colloquial) to come down.

exercises.q: ___ (расползаться — to crawl away) с поля люди и оставляют за собой трупы.
exercises.why: The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "**с**": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "**-ся**" the verb **встречать** — **встретить** is used with the direct object in the Accusative case: *Вчера я встретил моего друга.* but: *Мы встретились на улице.* We already know that the verbs in "**-ся**" may be divided into several groups. Verbs which never occur without the ending "**-ся**": *Я боюсь вашего брата.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 66–67.  ·  From Максим Горький, «Жизнь Клима Самгина».
exercises.context: The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "**с**": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "**-ся**" the verb **встречать** — **встретить** is used with the direct object in the Accusative…
